title: Peach Embroidered Kurti with Side Tie-Up
description:
Komal means “soft” – a gentle peach kurti, light and easy to wear.

A soft peach kurti in light georgette, with a round neck and elbow sleeves. A breezy straight kurti with delicate white thread embroidery scattered all over. The lined bodice sits above a sheer lower panel, with side tie-up cords and tassels that let you adjust the fit, and a keyhole back with a button closure.

Style it with jeans for college or office, or with palazzos for festive days. Made in Jaipur.

✦ Why Peach
Peach is a soft, warm pastel that suits day functions, baby showers and spring and summer weddings, and it photographs beautifully in daylight. The white embroidery keeps it fresh rather than sweet.

✦ How to Wear It
Wear it with white palazzos and pearl studs for a puja or brunch, or with light-wash jeans and tan flats for a casual day. A mint or ivory dupatta adds a festive touch.

✦ Fit, Size & Care
Regular fit, about 46 inches long. Choose your usual size and tie the side cords to adjust. Sizes XS–3XL, or free custom fit. Gentle hand wash or dry clean.
care: Gentle hand wash or dry clean.
